Hardware: single AMD Strix Halo 128GB, binaries as pinned in configs/. battery = the grader version the cell ran under. Dates ISO. Overnight re-runs 2026-09-20: iten12 v3.1 uniform across models; aime yearsplit cells; fcb15 census for 3 more models. 27B+sharp uniform cell landed.

vanilla_battery_suite: BLOCKER 0 (root, supersedes the churn story): SIX full-box crash-reboots tonight (21:38/21:48/21:57/22:00/22:05/22:10), each within minutes of a vanilla unit start, no panic/OOM trace - vanilla b11147's COLD full-model GTT load hard-crashes the machine. The 21:05 q8-KV probe survived on a cache-warm load (different path; its 36.6/32.0 numbers stand). No further unattended vanilla loads; supervised daytime repro + dmesg capture + upstream report required. RESOLVED 260924 by supervised repro: trigger = unified-memory over-commit during vanilla load; signature = zero kernel output, <=5s death window, instant SoC reset (watchdog-class); see crash_repro_260924. Fork unaffected.

BLOCKER 1 (solid): the fork's shared-MTP draft GGUF fails to load on upstream - 'check_tensor_dims: token_embd.weight not found' at 0.6s, deterministic, every -c. The shared draft (no own token_embd, borrows the main model's) is fork-format; upstream expects a self-contained draft. Vanilla must run draft-less until a standalone MTP GGUF is sourced (z-lab/dzannotti repos are candidates). RESOLVED 260924: PR #27836 unmerged - upstream cannot load a detached MTP head at all (crusaderky a82a58a is fork-only). The shared fork-format draft loads NONDETERMINISTICALLY on upstream (failed 21:03, loaded 21:04).

BLOCKER 2 (unrooted): even draft-less, the full ~100G vanilla load dies silently on strixy2 (no process, no kernel OOM, no journal exit line - consistent with the user-manager churn that killed units all night at load windows). Small loads (-c 2048) listen fine; the fork binary loads the same model fine. Needs daytime forensics with the box quiet.
Also: c=196608 AND c=163840 never got a clean test (blocked behind blocker 1/2) - the pp@128k@>=160k cell remains owed on vanilla.

crash_repro_260924.root_cause: GGML_HIP_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY allocation exceeding physical unified memory hard-locks the SoC silently (no OOM/no amdgpu trace/no panic). Community-known class: PR #27836 comment (flobob45, gfx1151): 'GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=1 crashed silently at load'. The fork (llama-pw) survives the same footprint (Q5+shared draft @131k serves daily).
crash_repro_260924.pr_27836_status: OPEN DRAFT, NOT MERGED upstream - fee39dd92 has only the --spec-* CLI scaffolding; the qwen4exp MTP implementation + detached-head loader (crusaderky a82a58a) are fork-only. drluoto's assembled ROCm branch: drluoto/llama.cpp@strix-halo-flash-next (+ Q8_0 sidecar HF drluoto/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP-GGUF); their production stack runs UD-IQ4_XS (93.7G) because Q5_K_XL+KV does not fit a non-spilling HIP carve-out.
